description: This is it. The Hall of Famer. The MVP of Teriyaki. Marinated, hand-trimmed, fresh, all-natural grilled chicken thigh served with our house-made teriyaki sauce. Add some white rice, brown rice, fried rice or noodles and stir-fried veggies. So good, you have to give us a little money to get it.

name: Mad Spicy Chicken Bowl
description: A whole new flavor (and level of heat)! This is not just our famous spicy chicken with the volume turned up, this is a whole new bowl! Our fresh chicken teriyaki is first wok-tossed with our signature spicy sauce and then wok-tossed with our new signature MAD SAUCE and placed on your choice of white rice, brown rice, fried rice or noodles and includes stir-fry veggies!

name: Mad Spicy Steak Bowl
description: A spicy twist on our steak teriyaki bowl! Fire at first, then sweet and tangy. Hand-trimmed, lean, marinated steak wok-tossed in our new, signature MAD SAUCE! Tossed over your choice of white rice, brown rice, fried rice or noodles and includes stir-fry veggies! A fiery protein-powered meal.

description: Whoa – spicy and sweet in one bowl? That’s Mad! Try our new Mad Orange bowl with our delicious orange chicken first wok-tossed with our famous orange sauce and then tossed with our new MAD SAUCE! Piled over your choice of white rice, brown rice, fried rice or noodles and includes stir-fry veggies!

name: Mad Spicy Tofu Bowl
description: Crisp tofu on the outside, soft on the inside. Our Spicy Tofu is amazing, but you have to try this new MAD SPICY tofu wok-tossed with our new MAD SAUCE! Piled over your choice of white rice, brown rice, fried rice or noodles and includes stir-fry veggies! Even carnivores will love it!

It continues as a flavor phenomenon to this very day. Chocolate Fudge Brownie is a fan-favorite chocolate extravaganza, mixing chocolate ice cream with ridiculously delicious Greyston Bakery brownies. It’s been satisfying chocolate lovers since 1991. We know it can be hard to choose between those two legendary flavors. With Half Baked, you don’t have to! We work with Fairtrade certified producers for all the cocoa, sugar, and vanilla in our recipes. Greyston Bakery, one of the largest social enterprises in the US, provides the scrumptious brownies for this and all of our frozen dessert flavors. name: B&J PHISH FOOD PT
description: "Chocolate ice cream with gooey marshmallow, caramel swirls and fudge fish. It’s delicious, but how did it come to be? Ben had been pondering the lack of a good marshmallow ice cream for years. “Most attempts at marshmallow were wispy. You can see the white streaks, but you can't taste them, you can't feel them, you can't experience the true glorious marshmallowness of it all,” Ben remembers. Well, back in 1995, we suggested to the rock band Phish that we celebrate our shared Vermont, USA, roots by creating a Phish flavor. As the wheel started turning on the collaboration, Ben saw an opportunity to solve the marshmallow conundrum once and for all. Starting with a base of rich chocolate ice cream, he and our flavor gurus started bringing the band test tubs of the evolving concoction. “We ate a lot of test tubs around the table with Phish. We’ve done flavors with other artists and entities, but nobody was more involved in creating the flavor than Phish was,” Jerry says. The band was instrumental, for example, in calling for caramel swirl, an addition that pushed the flavor over the top. We work with Fairtrade certified producers for cocoa, sugar and vanilla. description: "Sweet cream ice cream with chunks of blonde brownies and a salted caramel core. Brace yourself, folks…this flavor is out-of-this-world euphoric. One of our most decadent Cores! Dig straight down through the gooey center of salted caramel, or work the perimeter, devouring the chunks of blonde brownies. Either way, you’ll be in total control of your ice cream destiny. What’s even better is that the brownies in this all-out amazing flavor come fresh from Greyston Bakery, located in Yonkers, New York. Since 1982, this social enterprise has been paving the way to success for many of the city’s low-income residents through employment and education. Like all of Ben & Jerry’s ice cream, Salted Caramel Core strives to not just taste good, but do good, by featuring non-GMO sourced ingredients, eggs from cage-free hens, and Fairtrade certified sugar and vanilla. No artificial colors or flavors make this a frozen dessert your taste buds can trust. name: B&J PHISH FOOD PT
description: "Chocolate ice cream with gooey marshmallow, caramel swirls and fudge fish. It’s delicious, but how did it come to be? Ben had been pondering the lack of a good marshmallow ice cream for years. “Most attempts at marshmallow were wispy. You can see the white streaks, but you can't taste them, you can't feel them, you can't experience the true glorious marshmallowness of it all,” Ben remembers. Well, back in 1995, we suggested to the rock band Phish that we celebrate our shared Vermont, USA, roots by creating a Phish flavor. As the wheel started turning on the collaboration, Ben saw an opportunity to solve the marshmallow conundrum once and for all. Starting with a base of rich chocolate ice cream, he and our flavor gurus started bringing the band test tubs of the evolving concoction. “We ate a lot of test tubs around the table with Phish. We’ve done flavors with other artists and entities, but nobody was more involved in creating the flavor than Phish was,” Jerry says. The band was instrumental, for example, in calling for caramel swirl, an addition that pushed the flavor over the top. We work with Fairtrade certified producers for cocoa, sugar and vanilla. All of Ben & Jerry’s ice cream is made with non-GMO sourced ingredients and cage-free eggs. Ben & Jerry’s uses responsibly sourced packaging. "

It continues as a flavor phenomenon to this very day. Chocolate Fudge Brownie is a fan-favorite chocolate extravaganza, mixing chocolate ice cream with ridiculously delicious Greyston Bakery brownies. It’s been satisfying chocolate lovers since 1991. We know it can be hard to choose between those two legendary flavors. With Half Baked, you don’t have to! We work with Fairtrade certified producers for all the cocoa, sugar, and vanilla in our recipes. Greyston Bakery, one of the largest social enterprises in the US, provides the scrumptious brownies for this and all of our frozen dessert flavors. description: Rebaja-té es una mezcla de exquisito sabor con té verde orgánico Chun Mee, rooibos orgánico, mate, canela y cúrcuma orgánica de Puerto Rico. En taza, este blend presenta un color ámbar, que ofrece delicadas notas a rooibos entremezcladas con canela. Cantidad: 56 gramos / 2 oz (aprox. 28 tazas / 2 gramos cada una). Es una mezcla refrescante, donde ningún sabor sobresalta, resultando en una combinación perfecta con buen cuerpo. El té Moruno, como algunos le llaman, es ideal para los días calurosos. En taza presenta un color ámbar, con balanceado aroma y sabor en paladar. Cantidad: 56 gramos / 2 oz (aprox. 28 tazas / 2 gramos cada una). Ingredientes: té verde y menta. Nivel de cafeína:☕ ☕ Mediana-Baja (16-25mg). Preparación: Cantidad- 1 cucharadita por 8 onzas. Temperatura del agua- 175° -185°F. Tiempo de infusión- 2-3 minutos.

description: Matcha se produce con hojas cultivadas en la sombra para aumentar el contenido de clorofila. Las hojas son luego recogidas a mano, secadas al vapor y pulverizadas. Es extremadamente alto en antioxidantes. Nuestro Matcha es uno de alta calidad e ideal para impulsar el metabolismo, mejorar la concentración y reducir el estrés. ¡El té perfecto anti-envejecimiento! Cantidad: 84 gramos/ 3 onzas (aproxidamente. 52 tazas / 2 gramos cada una). Ingredientes: té verde orgánico (non GMO). Nivel de Cafeína:☕ ☕ Mediana-Baja (16-25mg). Preparación: Cantidad- 1 cda por 8 onzas. Temperatura del agua- 175° -185°F. Tiempo de infusión- 2-3 minutos.

name: Alou Thé - Oolong Masala Chai
description: Oolong Masala Chai es una mezcla con propiedades energizantes. Es equilibrado y perfecto para comenzar los nuevos retos de cada día. El té Oolong es uno de los secretos mejor guardados para regular el peso y la buena salud. Oolong Masala Chai es una infusión ayurvédica con cardamomo, jengibre, canela, mate argentino y piel de naranja. En taza presenta un color anaranjado, aroma de especias y sabor balanceado al paladar. description: Apple Caramel Chai es una mezcla energizante con dejos a especias. Combina té negro, manzana, pétalos de rosa, canela, cardamomo, jengibre, pimienta rosa, cáscara de naranja y esencia a caramelo. Resultando en una exótica mezcla que tienta los sentidos sorbo a sorbo. En tasa presenta un color amarronado, aroma de especias y sabor balanceado al paladar. name: Alou Thé - Masala Chai
description: Masala Chai es una mezcla de té negro, canela, jengibre, cardamomo y clavo de olor. En la cultura india, "Masala" significa "una mezcla de especias" y "chai" significa "té". Por lo tanto, Masala Chai es literalmente "té con especias". Nuestra interpretación intenta mantenerse fiel a su definición de fragancia cálida y atractiva, notas de especias y un acabado aromático vigorizante. Pulverizar para pastelería, "chai latte" o mayor intensidad de especias al paladar. Cantidad: 56 gramos / 2 onzas (aprox. 28 tazas / 2 gramos cada una). Al igual que el té verde, contiene gran cantidad de antioxidantes que combaten los radicales libres. En tasa presenta un color rojizo, con notas dulces entremezcladas con especias. No astringente. Don’t apologize, it’d be weirder if you weren’t drooling right now.

And perhaps that planet with the cool rings around it.

One more time for emphasis. Toasted. Sourdough. Bread. See? Now you’re hungry.

Now, you want a poster too, huh?

name: PHILLY CHEESESTEAK
description: The original. The classic. The Steak Philly. Our steak philly cheesesteak is always made with high-quality USDA choice steak, grilled and seasoned to perfection. We add savory grilled green peppers, mushrooms, and onions and top off our cheesesteak with melted provolone cheese. This delicious cheesesteak is always served on a signature toasted roll. All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Steak Philly pairs perfectly with French Fries or Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Bacon 3 Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Cheese and Bacon Fries or a soft drink.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Chicken Philly pairs perfectly with the not-too-sweet, not-too-tart taste of Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

The Fiesta Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Fiesta Fries and a real-fruit lemonade.

This cheesesteak features chicken seasoned just right and grilled with fresh green peppers, savory onions, and sliced mushrooms. We top the Chicken Philly with smooth, melted provolone cheese and serve it on our signature toasted roll. We love steak, but this chicken cheesesteak gives the Steak Philly a run for its money. All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Chicken Philly pairs perfectly with the not-too-sweet, not-too-tart taste of Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

name: PHILLY CHEESESTEAK
description: The original. The classic. The Steak Philly. Our steak philly cheesesteak is always made with high-quality USDA choice steak, grilled and seasoned to perfection. We add savory grilled green peppers, mushrooms, and onions and top off our cheesesteak with melted provolone cheese. This delicious cheesesteak is always served on a signature toasted roll. All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Steak Philly pairs perfectly with French Fries or Original Real-Fruit Lemonade.

name: CHICKEN CALIFORNIA
description: Our Chicken California cheesesteak is the perfect blend of savory, creamy, and zesty. We season and grill USDA-choice chicken and melt in smooth provolone cheese. We serve it on our signature toasted roll to add some crispiness to every bite of your cheesesteak. Then we top it off with creamy ranch dressing. What’s not to love? All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Chicken California pairs perfectly with Cheese and Bacon Fries or Real-Fruit Strawberry Lemonade.

name: CHICKEN BUFFALO
description: Who says a sandwich can’t bring the heat? Our Chicken Buffalo cheesesteak features USDA-choice grilled chicken infused with spicy buffalo sauce and topped with smooth, melted provolone cheese. All served on our signature toasted roll. We recommend adding some ranch dressing to this buffalo chicken cheesesteak if you want to bring down the spice. All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Pepperoni Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Original French Fries or a Real-Fruit Peach Lemonade.

name: BACON 3 CHEESESTEAK

This steak and bacon cheesesteak is served on our signature toasted roll for extra crispiness in every bite. All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Bacon 3 Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Cheese and Bacon Fries or a soft drink.

All cheesesteaks come with optional creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle. The Chicken Teriyaki Cheesesteak pairs perfectly with Ultimate Fries or a Real-Fruit Blueberry Lemonade.

name: Ultimate Cheeseburger™

And perhaps that planet with the cool rings around it.

And perhaps that planet with the cool rings around it.
